runtime_overlay.purpose: Avoid per-trial Codex installation as a local resource and timeout confound during the measured Harbor run.
runtime_overlay.unchanged_contract: All instructions, task metadata, tool schemas, private sidecar code and state, verifier code, oracle plans, and solutions were byte-identical to the released tasks.

selection: Full FactoryBench-100 v3.0.0 suite (100/100 tasks); high-level human requests, multi-source investigation, and task-specific deterministic scoring. Runtime overlay changed only the agent image to preinstall Codex 0.150.1; all semantic task and verifier files matched the released tree.
